source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 22.3.1 (PDF 197-198) with the insect example and the bar chart.

blocks.text: Bar chart (ya bar graph) data ki tasveeri shakal hai jis mein categorical data (qismon wala data, jaise species ke naam) mustateel (rectangle) bars se dikhaya jata hai; har bar ki lambai ya unchai us qeemat ke barabar nisbat (proportional) mein hoti hai jo woh dikhata hai. Bar charts alag alag qismon ya groups ki miqdar ka muqabla karne ke liye bante hain. Biology mein yeh mukhtalif species ki ginti, experiment ke groups, ya biological samples ki naap dikhane ke liye bohat kaam ke hain. Bar chart ki bunyadi khasiyatein:

items: Qismein (categories) x-axis (ufqi, horizontal lakeer) par hoti hain.
Qeematein ya frequencies y-axis (amoodi, vertical lakeer) par hoti hain.
Bars khari (vertical) ya leti (horizontal) dono tarah ban sakti hain.

blocks.text: Research ke talaba ne aik maqami jangal mein keeron ki iqsaam (insect diversity) ka mutala kiya aur aik mahine tak paanch aam keeron ki species ke afraad (individuals) gine.

blocks.caption: Keeron ki species ki nisbati tadaad (kitab ka table)

items: Maqsad: paanch species ki tadaad ka tasveer se muqabla karna.
Categorical variable (qisam wala variable): insect species (ladybug, ant, butterfly, bee, dragonfly).
Numerical variable (adadi variable): gine gaye afraad ki tadaad.
X-axis (categorical): insect species.
Y-axis (numerical): gine gaye afraad ki tadaad.

blocks.text: Qadam 3: numerical axis ka scale banayein.
Sab se bari qeemat 120 (ants) hai, is liye y-axis 0 se 130 ya 140 tak rakhein. Parhne mein aasani ke liye 10 ya 20 ka waqfa (increment) rakha jata hai. Hum 0 se 140 tak, 20 ke waqfe se chunte hain.

items: Ladybug ka bar y-axis par 45 tak.
Ant ka bar 120 tak.
Butterfly ka bar 30 tak.
Bee ka bar 75 tak.
Dragonfly ka bar 20 tak.
Tamam bars ki chaurai barabar aur un ke darmiyan faasla yaksaan rakhein.
Chart ka title: Insect species abundance in local forest
X-axis label: Insect species
Y-axis label: Number of individuals

blocks.alt: Bar chart: INSECT SPECIES ABUNDANCE IN LOCAL FOREST. Y-axis Number of individuals (afraad ki tadaad), 0 se 140 tak 20 ke qadmon mein; x-axis Insect species. Paanch rangeen bars: Ladybug 45 (16%), Ant 120 (41%), Butterfly 30 (10%), Bee 75 (26%), Dragonfly 20 (7%); har bar ke oopar feesad aur paanchon species ka rangon wala legend.
blocks.caption: Maqami jangal mein keeron ki species ki nisbati tadaad ka bar chart (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Kitab ke chhape bar chart mein y-axis par 'Abundance (%)' likha hai, lekin bars ginti (45, 120, 30, 75, 20) tak jati hain aur kitab ke apne qadam 5 mein y-axis ka naam 'Number of individuals' hai. Is liye yahan sahih naam 'Number of individuals' likha hai. Kitab ke legend mein sirf teen species (Ladybug, Ant, Butterfly) thin; yahan paanchon ka legend poora kiya gaya hai.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: Bars ki unchai ginti dikhati hai; har bar ke oopar likha feesad 290 keeron (45 + 120 + 30 + 75 + 20) mein se us species ka hissa hai, maslan ants: 120/290 × 100 ≈ 41%.
blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein

blocks.text: Legend chart, graph ya naqshe par aik kunji (key) hai jo batati hai ke istemal hone wali alamaton, rangon, patterns ya labels ka kya matlab hai. Is se dekhne wala samajh jata hai ke har cheez kya dikhati hai, aur data samajhna aasan hota hai. Maslan jis bar chart mein har qisam ka rang alag ho, us ka legend batata hai ke kaun sa rang kis qisam ka hai.
blocks.title: Legend

blocks.prompt: 290 keeron mein ants 120 hain. Table ka feesad (41%) check karein.
blocks.explanation: 120 / 290 × 100 = 41.4, yani taqreeban 41%, jaisa table mein hai.

items: Bar chart: x-axis par qismein, y-axis par qeematein; bars ki chaurai barabar aur faasla yaksaan.
Scale sab se bari qeemat se zara oopar tak (0 se 140, 20 ke waqfe).
Title, axes ke labels aur zaroorat ho to legend.
